_comment: House settings for the house-pptx skill. Edit this file to point the skill at your own brand: font, template, palette, wordmark. Every script reads it through scripts/config.py. Paths are relative to the skill folder unless absolute.

_notes.wordmark_text: Text drawn top-right of every content slide by the HTML boilerplate. Leave empty for none. If your template's master already draws a logo there, set template_supplies_chrome to true so the translator skips the HTML wordmark and page number instead of doubling them.
_notes.font.faces: Leave empty for a system font (Arial, Calibri, Helvetica). For a brand font, give the four OTF/TTF filenames: {"regular": "Brand-Regular.otf", "bold": "Brand-Bold.otf", "italic": "Brand-Italic.otf", "bolditalic": "Brand-BoldItalic.otf"} and set HOUSE_PPTX_FONTDIR (or font_dir in house-pptx.json) to the directory that holds them.
_notes.template: Any 16:9 .pptx. Slides are placed on the layout named like 'Blank' by default; run  python scripts/list_layouts.py  to see what your template offers and choose with <body data-ppt-layout="...">.
_notes.palette: Role names are what the docs refer to. Change the values to your brand; keep the roles.
_notes.acronyms_extra: Brand names or acronyms genuinely styled in capitals, so typecheck.py does not flag them as shouting.
